name: Canva
description: Browse, summarize, autofill, and even generate new Canva designs directly from Claude. Make Canva a native part of your AI workflow—an AI-powered design agent that helps you create polished visuals faster, with less friction.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Canva to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Canva to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.canva.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Canva MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Canva scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Canva MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canva lists 17 MCP tools, including search-designs, get-design, get-design-pages, get-design-content, search, fetch, import-design-from-url, get-design-import-from-url-status, export-design, get-export-formats, get-design-export-status, and create-folder.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Canva?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Canva in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Canva requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Canva failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canva scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Canva is developed by Canva. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
